name: wickedapi-mcp
description: The whole Wicked suite in one MCP server — trading data, DeFi protocol health, token safety, brokerage sync, agent identity, reputation, tool registry, hallucination checks, persistent memory, and x402 paywalls. No signup: pay per call in USDC via x402, or use a partner API key.
long_description:
WickedAPI turns your agent's wallet into its API key.

Most APIs make you sign up, generate a key, and manage a subscription before your agent can ask a single question. This one skips all of that: point this server at a funded Base-mainnet wallet (`wickedapi_payer_private_key`) and every tool call auto-pays a fraction of a cent in USDC via x402 — no account, no dashboard, no monthly bill.

Don't have a wallet handy? It still works. Call any priced tool with no credentials and you'll get back the real x402 payment challenge (price, network, payTo address) instead of a dead end — and the Token Risk Oracle tool is free no matter what.

70 tools across the Wicked suite. The first four services are generated live from each service's own OpenAPI spec:
- **Trading Data API** (22, unprefixed): spot prices & OHLCV, Wilder ATR, Fair Value Gaps, ICT liquidity levels, perp funding/OI, long/short ratios, order-book depth, spot-vs-perp basis, Hyperliquid, Kalshi prediction markets, DeFi TVL, crypto Fear & Greed, a verified FOMC/CPI/jobs macro calendar, an earnings calendar, Ethereum gas, US Treasury yields, market clock, global crypto stats, and an AI momentum score.
- **Protocol Health Oracle** (6, `protocol_health_*`): live-scored DeFi protocol health across the full DefiLlama universe.
- **Token Risk Oracle** (1, `token_risk`, always free): real on-chain scam/rug-check signals for any EVM or Solana token.
- **Broker Sync API** (6, `broker_sync_*`): real positions, balances, and transactions across 30+ brokerages.
- **Wicked Reputation** (5, `reputation_*`, free): on-chain agent staking, tiers and reputation.
- **Wicked Registry** (6, `registry_*`): real uptime/latency/schema scores for x402 and MCP tools.
- **Wicked Identity** (6, `identity_*`): reverse-CAPTCHA / Know-Your-Agent verification with signed assertions.
- **Wicked Sanity** (2, `sanity_check*`): hallucination / eval check of a claim against your context or live web evidence.
- **Wicked Memory** (8, `memory_*`): persistent, wallet-scoped agent memory with semantic search and versioned history.
- **x402 Paywall** (8, `paywall_*`): put any HTTP endpoint behind pay-per-call USDC on Base.

Identity, Registry registration and Memory never sign anything or hold a key: you supply the wallet signature yourself.

Plus 6 resources (the platform directory, llms.txt, and each service's live catalog) and 7 prompts (`rug_check`, `vet_dependency`, `morning_briefing`, `fact_check`, `verify_agent`, `find_reliable_tool`, `agent_memory_guide`) that chain tools together into one-click workflows.

No fabricated data, ever — upstream failures return a real error, never a made-up number.

wickedapi_payer_private_key.title: Base Wallet Private Key (recommended)
wickedapi_payer_private_key.description: A funded Base-mainnet wallet private key. If set, every call auto-pays the x402 challenge in USDC (~$0.001/call) — no API key or signup needed.

wickedapi_api_key.title: API Key (optional)
wickedapi_api_key.description: A free, rate-limited partner API key, if you have one. Not required if you configure a payer wallet instead.

wickedapi_base_url.title: Trading Data API URL (advanced)
wickedapi_base_url.description: Override the Trading Data API base URL. Defaults to https://api.wickedapi.com.

wickedapi_protocol_health_url.title: Protocol Health Oracle URL (advanced)
wickedapi_protocol_health_url.description: Override the Protocol Health Oracle base URL. Defaults to https://protocol-health-oracle.wickedapi.com.

wickedapi_token_risk_url.title: Token Risk Oracle URL (advanced)
wickedapi_token_risk_url.description: Override the Token Risk Oracle base URL. Defaults to https://token-risk-oracle.wickedapi.com.

wickedapi_broker_sync_url.title: Broker Sync API URL (advanced)
wickedapi_broker_sync_url.description: Override the Broker Sync API base URL. Defaults to https://broker-sync-api.wickedapi.com.

registry_api_key.title: Wicked Registry API Key (optional)
registry_api_key.description: Free-tier key for registry_search_tools / registry_tool_detail. Omit to get the x402 payment challenge instead.

identity_api_key.title: Wicked Identity API Key (optional)
identity_api_key.description: Free-tier key for identity_status. Omit to get the x402 payment challenge instead.

sanity_api_key.title: Wicked Sanity API Key (optional)
sanity_api_key.description: Free-tier key for sanity_check / sanity_check_batch. Omit to get the x402 payment challenge instead.

memory_api_key.title: Wicked Memory API Key (optional)
memory_api_key.description: Free-tier key for the metered memory_search call. Memory still needs a wallet signature on every call.

paywall_api_key.title: x402 Paywall Tenant Key (optional)
paywall_api_key.description: Bearer key returned once by paywall_signup. Needed for the paywall_* route and settlement tools.
